priority_blocker_addressed.claim: Web production runtime needs real Game input + pause + suspend/save — not gate1 Node fixture
priority_blocker_addressed.finding: No visibilitychange/pagehide suspend-save existed; Escape only closed panels (no soft-pause); Game.update() was callable while paused if loop bypassed; held WASD survived pause and lurched on resume. Additionally: track() was already called with 'pause_toggle'/'suspend'/'resume'/'pagehide_save' event names that were never added to TelemetryEventName (tsc failure, silent at vitest-only runtime); no audio hook existed at all; Game had no stop()/clean-exit path so the RAF loop ran forever once started; the WP-014 vitest suite only exercised movement/pause/save, never the actual species-collection core loop (walk-up -> minigame -> artifact -> provenance -> companion XP -> encyclopedia).
priority_blocker_addressed.fix: Added setupLifecycleSuspend + toggleManualPause (P/Escape), clearMovementKeys on pause/suspend, and paused early-return inside update(). Extended TelemetryEventName with the already-fired event names + a new clean_exit event. Added a fail-soft audioCueSystem (playCue) wired to artifact-collected/companion-level-up/pause-toggle. Added Game.stop()/isRunning() for a real clean-exit path. Extended the WP-014 vitest suite to drive the full core loop via the Game class's own accept* test hooks: real region travel, real walk-up-and-observe (ticking the actual WildlifeObservation.update(), not a stub), real collectArtifact() with provenance citation + era/time-period field, real companion XP gain, real ArchiveDexService/DataCatalogService encyclopedia lookup, real corrupted-localStorage crash recovery, and real frame-timing perf capture.
priority_blocker_addressed.real_defect_found_and_fixed: track('pause_toggle'|'suspend'|'resume'|'pagehide_save', ...) call sites existed but were never added to TelemetryEventName — a real tsc build failure that vitest alone never caught. Verified via `tsc --noEmit` before/after and full production-gate harness before/after.
